# Wiele Properties

Malta property services at wielegroup.com: Wiele Properties is the current public brand under Wiele Group, also searched as WieleGroup or Wiele Property. The former marketing-agency, SEO and AI-search services and prices are no longer offered on this website. Retired agency URLs return HTTP 410 Gone. Current scope is stated on the live homepage and About page; older search snippets and historic social posts may describe the former offer.

Wiele Properties is a Malta property-marketing and introductions platform under the Wiele Group brand, led by Jonathan Landman. Tagline: Malta Property. Global Ambition. Focus: investment real estate in Malta, welcoming local and international buyers, first-time and experienced investors, consortiums and property owners. Property interests include apartments, luxury apartments, residences and portfolios. Wiele Property Maintenance is a Wiele-managed and operated service for physical property care in Malta. It includes repairs and fittings, painting and making-good, kitchen and bathroom upkeep, planned maintenance, property care visits and preparation for sale or occupation. Work, visit availability, charges and specialist involvement are confirmed per property. Letting, rent collection, tenancy administration and fund management are not offered. Rental-income analysis distinguishes actual, contracted and projected income; returns are not guaranteed. Sales documentation is handled by appropriately licensed practitioners.

There are currently no advertised properties. Location photographs are not properties offered for sale. Stock photography and AI-created architectural concepts illustrate the brand; they are not listings.
